A non-teaching Consultant/Specialist/Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least two years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (must complete BCBR within two years of appointment). Diploma holders appointed as Senior Residents in a recognised medical institution before 08.06.2017, with four years' total Senior Resident experience. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying. | Candidates from anywhere in India who meet the prescribed qualifications and eligibility criteria may apply. Tutor: Selection is based on the theory marks obtained in MBBS. Assistant Professor: Selection is based on the theory marks obtained in the MD/MS/DNB/MDS/M.Sc. (Clinical) postgraduate qualification. Where marks are not awarded in the qualifying exam
50% of the maximum marks is considered for this purpose. Teaching Experience: For all cadres/posts

the duration of teaching experience in the respective cadre/post is considered as one of the selection criteria. Rule of Reservation: Applicable only where more than one vacancy is notified under a particular post/category

as per applicable Government rules. DNB Candidates: Considered for selection as per the latest prevailing NMC guidelines. Additional Weightage: Extra weightage/points are given to candidates who have previously worked
at Government Medical College & General Hospital
Narayanpet. Final Authority: The decision of the Selection Committee is final and binding on all matters relating to recruitment and selection.

physical_eligibility.details: The appointment is purely temporary and contractual, valid up to 31.03.2027, or until the vacancy is filled through promotion/regular appointment, whichever is earlier. It does not confer any right or claim to regular appointment or future Government employment. Selected faculty are eligible for 15 days of Casual Leave and 5 Optional Holidays per calendar year, on a cumulative basis, subject to applicable rules. If a selected candidate does not join within the stipulated time, the next eligible candidate on the merit list may be considered. A candidate wishing to resign must give one month's prior notice; the institute may likewise terminate the contract with one month's notice, without assigning any reason. Selected faculty must be available to the institution on a whole-time basis and must submit an undertaking to render services during National Health Emergencies or other public health emergencies. Original certificates are verified at joining and remain in the custody of the Principal, Government Medical College, Narayanpet.

content_sections.heading: GMC Narayanpet Salary 2026 (Consolidated Remuneration)
content_sections.text: Remuneration is a consolidated, all-inclusive amount, subject to deduction of income tax and any other statutory deductions, as prescribed in G.O.Rt.No.1276, Finance (HRM.VII) Department, dated 16.07.2026. Salary/remuneration is payable strictly on the basis of attendance recorded through the Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS), as per applicable Government rules.

content_sections.heading: GMC Narayanpet Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made in accordance with the NMC Post-Graduate Medical Education Board's Teachers Eligibility Qualifications in Medical Institutions Regulations, 2024, and the following criteria set out in the notification: Tutor: Selection is based on the theory marks obtained in MBBS. Assistant Professor: Selection is based on the theory marks obtained in the MD/MS/DNB/MDS/M.Sc. (Clinical) postgraduate qualification. Where marks are not awarded in the qualifying exam, 50% of the maximum marks is considered for this purpose. Teaching Experience: For all cadres/posts, the duration of teaching experience in the respective cadre/post is considered as one of the selection criteria. Rule of Reservation: Applicable only where more than one vacancy is notified under a particular post/category, as per applicable Government rules. DNB Candidates: Considered for selection as per the latest prevailing NMC guidelines. Additional Weightage: Extra weightage/points are given to candidates who have previously worked, or are presently working, at Government Medical College & General Hospital, Narayanpet. Final Authority: The decision of the Selection Committee is final and binding on all matters relating to recruitment and selection.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This is a walk-in-interview recruitment, so there is no separate online application portal. The prescribed application form is made available on the official websites listed below. Download the prescribed Application Form from the official website of Government Medical College & General Hospital, Narayanpet, or the District Collector, Narayanpet website. Fill in the application form completely - incomplete applications will not be entertained. Attach one self-attested photocopy of each required enclosure (see list below) to the application. Report to the Office of the Principal, Government Medical College, Narayanpet on 02.09.2026, between 10:00 A.M. and 02:00 P.M., for the walk-in-interview. Carry two (2) sets of self-attested photocopies of all required documents, along with the original certificates for verification, and two (2) recent passport-size photographs. Aadhar Card PAN Card Proof of Date of Birth (SSC/Birth Certificate) Study/Bonafide Certificates (4th to 10th Class) MBBS and MD/MS/DNB Degree Certificates MBBS Registration from Telangana/Andhra Pradesh Medical Council; additional PG qualification registration from Telangana State Medical Council only (applications without this registration will be rejected). Outside-state candidates must get their qualification registered with the Telangana State Medical Council within one week of selection. Experience Certificates Senior Residency Completion Certificate BCBR Certificate and MET Certificate Marks Memo of MBBS and MD/MS/DNB/MDS/M.Sc. (Clinical) Degree MBBS Degree Certificate MD/MS/DNB/MDS/M.Sc. (Clinical) Degree Certificate, as applicable MBBS Registration Certificate MD/MS/DNB/Speciality Degree Registration Certificate, as applicable Senior Residency Certificate, wherever applicable Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) Certificate Medical Education Technologies (MET) Certificate, wherever applicable Teaching/Professional Experience Certificates Relieving Order from the previous institution, wherever applicable List of publications, with relevant publication documents/certificates No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates already working in another Government Medical College in Telangana

faq.question: Q1. What is GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contract-basis recruitment drive by Government Medical College, Narayanpet, Telangana, under Notification Rc.No.080/GMC/NRPT/2026 dated 12.08.2026, to fill Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Tutor, and CAS Specialist posts across 19 departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 61 vacancies across Professor (11), Associate Professor (20), and Assistant Professor (30) posts, plus 1 Tutor post and 4 CAS Specialist posts (2 in General Medicine, 2 in Pulmonary Medicine) under ICU. The notification states these numbers may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no separate online application deadline. The walk-in-interview is scheduled for 02.09.2026, and candidates must bring their filled application with documents on that date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post: MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor; MBBS for Tutor; and MD/DNB/Diploma in the concerned subject for CAS Specialist. Full post-wise details are in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts must be below 69 years of age. The age limit is not specified in the notification for Tutor and CAS Specialist posts.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the application form from the official GMC Narayanpet website or the Narayanpet District Collector's website, fill it in completely, and appear for the walk-in-interview on 02.09.2026 at the Office of the Principal, Government Medical College, Narayanpet, with the required documents.
